title: Improved iPhone usability
description: PGA and DP World leaderboards now keep wide tables inside a smooth swipe area, with larger touch targets on iPhone and iPad.

title: Corrected PGA winner scores
description: Previous FedEx St. Jude Championship winners now show the correct relative-to-par scores at TPC Southwind.

title: Featured current bets
description: Active outright and each-way bets now link directly to their filtered Odds & Value view.

title: Smarter off-week homepage
description: Tours without a current event now use a compact status card and schedule link.
